    required_letters = set("BINGO")
    return "WIN" if required_letters.issubset(letters) else "LOSE"

def bingo(array):
    letters = [chr(x + 64) for x in array]
    required_letters = set("BINGO")
    return "WIN" if required_letters.issubset(letters) else "LOSE"

def bingo(array):
    letters = [chr(i) for i in range(65, 91)]
    bingo_letters = [letters[num - 1] for num in array if 1 <= num <= 26]
    required_letters = set("BINGO")
    return "WIN" if required_letters.issubset(bingo_letters) else "LOSE"
